def transform(g):
    vals=sorted(set(v for r in g for v in r))
    bg=max(vals,key=lambda v:sum(r.count(v) for r in g))
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter()
    for r in g:
        j=0
        while j<len(r):
            if r[j]!=bg:
                k=j
                while k<len(r) and r[k]==r[j]: k+=1
                cnt[r[j]]+=1; j=k
            else: j+=1
    cols=3; rows=max(1,(sum(cnt.values())+cols-1)//cols)
    flat=[]
    for c in sorted(cnt): flat+= [c]*cnt[c]
    flat+= [0]*(rows*cols-len(flat))
    return [flat[i*cols:(i+1)*cols] for i in range(rows)]
